classification: Rogue developer-source port with independently authored campaign; not decompilation, emulator, retail campaign or clean-room certificate
referenceCodeLicense: BSD-3-Clause-style original-game grant plus separately retained save/crypt notices; root grant names Michael Toy, Ken Arnold and Glenn Wichman. Code grant is checked separately from media.

files.kind: Three fixed geometric layouts, encounter/item arrangements, station names and briefings

mapMethod: Geometry authored without reference-map input. Fixed encounters use native Rogue actor creation/stats, item effects and collision/combat; original procedural new_level.c and wandering-spawn fuse are excluded.
textMethod: Native control flow and meaning inspected; compatible replacement wording authored. Named tables replaced separately. 108 retained literals are reviewed functional formatting/parser/save/combat contracts. No clean-room-isolation claim.
glyphMethod: Own Beacon Relay/Vector Duel 3x5 family plus own punctuation/game-symbol patterns; no retail screenshot/font input.
animation: Native movement/effects redraw the authored glyphs; no original bitmap or animation files.
audio: No sound files or audio API/device; silent edition, audible verification unavailable.
excluded: original procedural layouts/end artwork/name and prose presentation
mdport.c and xcrypt.c in selected native link
rawLicensedReferenceSource: 48 pinned text files retained privately and in corresponding source for audit/rebuild, including historical source presentation. Runtime replaces selected presentation; no original media is bundled.
codeAndConstants: Rogue numeric gameplay tables, codec, symbols and functional identifiers retain their BSD code notices; own CC0 dedication does not relicense them.

sdk.notices: Emscripten MIT/NCSA and authors, musl MIT/individual notices, LLVM Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, dlmalloc public-domain and Emscripten adaptation notices; selected JS MIT prefixes retained.

releaseGate: Source/content and private native campaign tested; site and production gates recorded separately.
